summary: @or-sdk/auth preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun), extracts it, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is identifier-obfuscated (`_0x…` names, dictionary-lookup wrappers). `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled CommonJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with shuffled string-array + numeric-index obfuscation whose contents cannot be statically reviewed. The Node-native `dist/cjs/index.js` main entry is unrelated boilerplate, so the obfuscated payload executes exclusively through the freshly-dropped Bun runtime at install time — bypassing Node-only inspection. An auth SDK does not require an alternate language runtime to be fetched and used to execute an opaque bundle on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
